items.stem:

"The longest mountain range on land is the (A) ______. The only ocean named after a country is the (B) ______ Ocean."
(i) Fill in blank (A). (1 mark)
(ii) Fill in blank (B). (1 mark)
(iii) Why is the Pacific Ocean called the largest ocean? (2 marks)
items.answer: (i) Andes (ii) Indian (iii) (1) It covers about one-third of the Earth's surface. (2) It is larger than all the land on Earth put together.

items.stem: Which of the following is a herding community?
items.answer: Bakarwals
items.markingKey: (c) Bakarwals is a herding community; Fishermen of Kerala, City traders, Mayan farmers are not.

items.stem: Name any three temperate grasslands.
items.answer: Any three of: Prairies, Pampas, Steppes, Velds, Downs.
items.markingKey: Any three correct: Prairies, Pampas, Steppes, Velds, Downs (2 marks for three, 1 mark for two).

items.stem:
Read the revision note prepared by a Class 8 student on "Major river systems and the civilisations and economies they support" and answer the questions that follow.
"The river that carries the largest volume of water in the world is the (A) ______. The river Huang He is also called the (B) ______ River."
(i) Fill in blank (A). (1 mark)
(ii) Fill in blank (B). (1 mark)
(iii) Why is the Huang He called "China's sorrow"? (2 marks)
items.answer: (i) Amazon (ii) Yellow (iii) (1) It floods often and changes its course. (2) Floods destroy crops, homes and lives.
items.markingKey: (i) Amazon – 1 mark. (ii) Yellow – 1 mark. (iii) any two points, 1 mark each: (1) It floods often and changes its course. (2) Floods destroy crops, homes and lives.

items.stem: What is meant by 'Mediterranean climate'?
items.answer: A climate of hot dry summers and mild rainy winters, good for citrus fruits and grapes.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for the idea: a climate of hot dry summers and mild rainy winters, good for citrus fruits and grapes.

items.stem:
Assertion (A): The temperate grasslands of South Africa are called the Prairies.
Reason (R): The largest tropical rainforest in the world is in the Amazon basin.
Choose the correct option.
items.answer: A is false, but R is true.
items.markingKey: (d) A is false: The temperate grasslands of South Africa are called the Velds. R is true.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

items.stem: Which of the following correctly describes 'continent'?
items.answer: A very large landmass of the Earth, such as Asia or Africa
items.markingKey: (d) 'Continent' means a very large landmass of the Earth, such as Asia or Africa; the other options describe other terms of this chapter.
options: A smaller river that joins a main river

A huge body of salt water surrounding the continents

items.stem:
Match Column A with Column B and choose the correct option.
Column A:
1. Continent
2. Nomadic herding
3. Tributary
4. River basin
Column B:
(p) Moving from place to place with animals in search of pasture and water
(q) A very large landmass of the Earth, such as Asia or Africa
(r) A smaller river that joins a main river
(s) The area drained by a river and its tributaries
items.markingKey: (c) Continent – a very large landmass of the Earth, such as Asia or Africa; Nomadic herding – moving from place to place with animals in search of pasture and water; Tributary – a smaller river that joins a main river; River basin – the area drained by a river and its tributaries.

items.stem: On an outline political map of the world, locate and label the following: (a) The Andes mountains (b) The Strait of Gibraltar (c) The Mariana Trench
items.answer: (a) Andes – western South America (b) Strait of Gibraltar – between Spain and Morocco (c) Mariana Trench – western Pacific Ocean
items.markingKey: 1 mark for each correct location: (a) Andes – western South America (b) Strait of Gibraltar – between Spain and Morocco (c) Mariana Trench – western Pacific Ocean

items.stem: Which of the following is a temperate grassland?
items.answer: Velds
items.markingKey: (c) Velds is a temperate grassland; Sahara, Selvas, Tundra are not.

items.stem: Define the term 'inland waterway'.
items.answer: A river or canal used to carry goods and passengers by boat.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for the idea: a river or canal used to carry goods and passengers by boat.

items.stem:
Match Column A with Column B and choose the correct option.
Column A:
1. Equatorial region
2. Savanna
3. Plateau
4. Continent
Column B:
(p) Tropical grasslands with tall grass and scattered trees, as in East Africa
(q) A very large landmass of the Earth, such as Asia or Africa
(r) An elevated area of flat land rising sharply above the surrounding area
(s) The hot, wet belt near the Equator with rain almost every day and dense evergreen forests
items.markingKey: (c) Equatorial region – the hot, wet belt near the Equator with rain almost every day and dense evergreen forests; Savanna – tropical grasslands with tall grass and scattered trees, as in East Africa; Plateau – an elevated area of flat land rising sharply above the surrounding area; Continent – a very large landmass of the Earth, such as Asia or Africa.

items.stem: State whether the statement is True or False: The Inuit traditionally lived in snow houses called igloos.
items.answer: True
